claim_ceiling: This register records discoverable candidate sources and known access/rights facts. No live GIS, population, service, public-space or timetable layer has been ingested or qualified by this register.

sources.name: Climate.OneBuilding 2026 TMYx building-simulation weather files
sources.publisher: Climate.OneBuilding.org; source datasets include NOAA ISD and ERA5-derived solar data
known_facts: Portal describes hourly TMY weather data in EPW and associated simulation formats.
2026 release includes TMYx all-data files and 2011-2025 / 2009-2023 / 2007-2021 periods where available.
Portal states 2026 TMYx solar data use ERA5 reanalysis.
unknowns: Exact Johannesburg or nearest-station file and station representativeness
Per-file source record, period, missingness and data-quality flags
Per-file redistribution/licence terms
Suitability for extreme-event or future-climate design
required_checks: Locate exact Johannesburg-area file and source metadata
Record WMO/site ID, coordinates/elevation, period, climate variables, time zone, digest and retrieval date
Check rights for redistribution
Use only as TMY screening; never label a TMY sequence an observed heatwave or future projection
Inspect both candidate EPW/STAT/COMMENT1 headers and compare station coordinates/elevation/period before choosing a reference profile
Retain both candidates for sensitivity/representativeness comparison; do not choose the airport or botanical garden simply by proximity or name

notes: TMYx 2011-2025 candidate on Climate.OneBuilding Gauteng list.
Airport exposure may not represent dense urban or valley microclimates.
Requires EPW/STAT/COMMENT1 inspection, exact lat/lon/elevation, period and solar metadata, time-zone checks, missingness and licence review.

Requires EPW/STAT/COMMENT1 inspection, exact lat/lon/elevation, period and solar metadata, time-zone checks, missingness and licence review.

sources.name: GCRO Quality of Life Survey 7 (2023/24)
sources.publisher: GCRO; distributed by DataFirst, University of Cape Town
sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0), public-use anonymised dataset as stated by GCRO/DataFirst

Survey data have weights and technical documentation that must be used.

sources.name: Assessment of disposal methods of construction and demolition waste: a case study of south-eastern industrial and residential areas in Johannesburg, South Africa
sources.geography: South-eastern industrial and residential areas of Johannesburg; qualitative participant study
known_facts: The study reports interviews with 20 private-sector stakeholders.
All 20 participants indicated using landfill; landfill was reported as the most economical route in the participant accounts.
The paper discusses barriers in implementation, registration and recordkeeping and recommends waste reduction, reuse and recycling before landfill.
unknowns: Citywide representativeness
Measured tonnage by material or project
Complete informal-sector reuse flows
Current prices or current landfill capacity
required_checks: Use as qualitative evidence of incentive and operational barriers, not a citywide disposal percentage.
Do not treat 20 interview responses as a statistically representative sample of Johannesburg projects.
Use the findings to design stakeholder interviews and material-recovery fieldwork.

sources.name: Human Settlements and the Circular Economy — Johannesburg deconstruction and reuse scenario
sources.publisher: Circular Economy South Africa / Human Settlements research report
known_facts: The report presents a City of Johannesburg model scenario in which 50% adoption of reuse of materials/products from building deconstruction could salvage 225.21 kt and reduce material otherwise landfilled or fly-tipped by about 44%.
The figure is a modeled adoption scenario and not a measurement of available, qualified or deliverable stock.
unknowns: Input inventory completeness and local building-condition representativeness
Grade, testing, contamination and custody by salvaged component
Actual adoption feasibility, project timing, handling/storage and transport constraints
Realized recovery yield and receiving-market demand
required_checks: Retain the scenario assumptions and source methodology before attempting reproduction.
Never use the 225.21 kt scenario result as physical inventory or procurement supply.
Reproduce the modeled case under its original functional unit and boundary before creating new scenario variations.

unknowns: Current applicability to modern climate and code

Copyright/reuse status
required_checks: Use only as contextual historical guidance
Verify current legal/technical requirements separately
Do not use as a weather dataset or quantified modern performance baseline

sources.name: An estimate of construction and demolition waste quantities and composition expected in South Africa
known_facts: The paper estimated 20.2 Mt of potential C&D waste generated in South Africa in 2017 using a lifetime method and 10.8 Mt reaching disposal sites using a per-capita method, compared with 4.48 Mt in official statistics for 2017.
The paper identifies likely underreporting and notes informal sector reuse of discarded construction materials as a plausible contributor to differences.
unknowns: Current Johannesburg building/material stocks
Current recoverable or qualified quantities
Project-specific grade, condition, contamination, custody and availability
Reuse flows not captured by the study's underlying data
required_checks: Treat the estimates as research evidence of data-coverage risk, not a current supply total.
Do not compare different estimation methods as if they shared the same system boundary.
Do not convert national generated/disposed quantities into local usable supply.
Record uncertainty and study year whenever citing these estimates.

sources.name: South African building energy regulation / SANS 10400-XA edition status
sources.publisher: IEA policy database references South African regulation; SABS is the standards publisher
known_facts: IEA policy entry records SANS 10400-XA:2021 as in force and was last updated 2024-04-30.
Some 2026 trade/industry references mention a SANS 10400-XA:2026 publication; this inventory has not verified the official SABS edition/catalogue or its incorporation into regulations.
unknowns: Official current SABS edition and publication date
Whether a 2026 edition has been published and what legal status it has
Exact applicable clauses and referenced standards for each occupancy and compliance path
Rights to reproduce standard text
required_checks: Verify directly against SABS official catalogue and Government Gazette/regulatory adoption
Ask a competent South African building-energy professional to confirm the edition applicable on the project's submission date
Do not encode secondary website snippets as compliance law
Do not reproduce copyrighted standard text without permission

known_facts: Stats SA states that spreadsheets, a technical note, ward shapefiles and provincial/district maps are available.
Stats SA warns that very small-area census values can be unstable due to variability, bias and undercount; the release is described as the last lowest-level ward estimate product.
unknowns: Explicit reuse/redistribution licence for each downloadable file
CRS and exact schema for each file
Methodological uncertainty measures and reliability by ward
required_checks: Download technical note, spreadsheets and ward boundaries
Record the 2020 boundary crosswalk and population totals
Preserve age/sex and population-group definitions exactly as published
Do not downscale ward totals to buildings without a separately validated model

minimum_ingestion_contract.privacy_default: No individual survey coordinates, household addresses or person-level mobility traces in the public benchmark
minimum_ingestion_contract.absence_semantics: An unrecorded facility, material flow or informal recovery channel is Unknown unless the source's coverage and observation process establish that absence. Missing records must never be interpreted as zero stock or zero recovery.
weather_profile_requirement: weather_class must be one of observed_station, observed_reanalysis, typical_meteorological_year, design_extreme, observed_event, future_projection, synthetic_fixture
TMY cannot be relabelled heatwave, observed event, forecast or future projection
exact station/grid, period, variables, units, timezone, quality and spatial representativeness must be recorded
minimum_ingestion_contract.spatial_claim_policy: No join may increase native spatial precision or turn ward/sample context into building/household attributes.
minimum_ingestion_contract.thermal_claim_policy: Modelled, calibrated-modelled, measured and independently accepted remain distinct; require owner-native model/sensor receipts.
